items.t: SolarEdge (SEDG) Stock Fair Value Falls As Analysts Weigh Weaker Solar Demand
items.sum: The fair value estimate for SolarEdge Technologies has shifted from US$37.11 to US$29.89, putting fresh attention on how analysts are framing risk and reward around the stock. items.t: Solar, Storage Suppliers Double Down On AI Data Center Bets
items.sum: Solar energy & battery storage companies are raising their bets on the next generation of AI data centers, with the topic dominating conversations at the recent RE+ trade show in Las Vegas.
